remarks: Beautiful & Updated Top-Floor Condo in Downtown Stamford! Located on the 11th (top) floor of a desirable, pet-friendly building. This spacious condo with modern upgrades and stunning city views. The unit features fresh paint throughout, brand-new oak VLP flooring, and a stylish kitchen with quartz countertops. Living here is hassle-free with all-inclusive amenities-cable TV, internet, and cooking gas are provided by the building. The only utility tenants cover is the monthly electricity bill. Building amenities include a sparkling swimming pool, gym, on-site laundry, storage room,24-hour security guard, and convenient visitor parking. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and public transportation, this apartment is the perfect blend of city living and accessibility. Experience a lifestyle of ease and convenience in one of Stamford's most desirable locations! This unit is listed for sale MLS # 24050393
